correctness.rationale: Exact before/after hub--leaf costs prove the iff certificate, and leaf--leaf swaps cannot improve either player. The quadratic lattice test accounts for strict endpoints; the continuum zero at (sqrt(3)-1)/2 and uniform empirical convergence prove the limit, O(1) lattice error and conditional welfare result. The standalone verifier passed 20,586 direct exact comparisons, 80,197 lattice checks, an exact five-type example and finite large-grid sanity checks. These checks are not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: The exact fraction of equilibria and the sharp irrational stable-hub band quantify equilibrium prevalence on the canonical irregular hub-and-spoke graph, beyond known existence and worst-case inefficiency. The conditional cost law gives a natural typical-efficiency benchmark, and the five-agent noninterval example establishes a genuine finite-population phenomenon; the result holds for all growing empirical-uniform populations.
